---
title: "CUPPA"
execute:
  echo: false
html-table-processing: none
---


```{r}
#| label: setup
source(here::here("_setup.R"))
tool <- "cuppa"
dat$data <- dat$data |>
  dplyr::filter(grepl(tool, .data$tool_parser))
dat$schemas <- dat$schemas |>
  dplyr::filter(.data$tool == {{ tool }})
```

## Prediction Summary

```{r}
#| label: cuppa_predsum
tbl_nm <- "cuppa_predsum"
d <- dat$data |>
  tw_utils$unnest_data(tbl_nm, schemas_all = dat$schemas)
d$res
```
